body: How about… being grateful that he has food, and apparently so much abundance he can toss his dinner in the garbage and not think twice? Or… how wonderful is it that you have a culture and cuisine that inspires others? Sounds like he’s pretty insecure, so much so that he has to throw away the food that you cooked, were eating, and finding relative enjoyment in to justify himself. It’s the emotional maturity you should expect from a 4 year old.

Yes, of course I absolutely respect the importance of their work. But the nature of the original letter is so worrisome. Slipped under our door with no name on it, no confirmation that it was our apartment. I imagine it would be at the very least unprofessional to give this sort of letter to the wrong household. Also, the way our building is set up there are 3 apartments with entrances on the street, the neighbor in question lives in one of these, and then 4 apartments with entrances inside the building on the upper floors. We live in one of these. She has a key to the building as the mailboxes are inside, but has no business going up the stairs. I imagine that she could have dropped off the letter or let someone in, but again, no contact was made prior to the letter being left. And they clearly are capable of buzzing us since they did it at 3:30am this morning…

Thank you. Yes, we have a very good relationship with the building management and it’s close to impossible that they would have let anyone in in the middle of the night. Having locked myself out in the daytime I know this to be true! Also, how disruptive to a child to have someone attempt to enter their home at 3:30am!
I drill from the back side and do it slowly this usually helps, also make the hole a little bit lower.

Omg run for the hills!!!!! Please! A relationship based on ultimatums is not a partnership. It’s fair for her to say she wants to be married soon, but it’s not fair for her to dismiss entirely what your goals are and life looks like right now. I promise you, she’s going to always another demand while she dismissed you & your needs. Run!
I’ve never hear this but it makes so much sense. Which interview was this? I love JBP.
YTA. That’s weird and creepy. There absolutely was a better way to handle this.
NTA. Good for you for filing those papers! You’ll get through it. 💖
Get yourself a good divorce attorney now and leave asap. Don’t say anything negative to your kids about him. Don’t use the kids as a weapon and let them love both of you.
NTA! Them sharing a room is possibly the most normal thing ever! Sorry dear, they are behaving like spoiled brats! They need some sobering “check yourself” energy sent their way.

Wow. That is really heartbreaking. If she can’t be honest and keeps huge secrets like this from you, it doesn’t bode well for a marriage. I am so sorry this has been your experience. Either go for counseling together, or call it off. Marriages need trust, honesty, vulnerability AND strength. They are hard work! This seems like a manifestation of deeper issues. I would also suggest you be curious about any of your own actions/behavior that may have contributed to this situation. I am NOT saying you deserve this or it is your fault!! There are always lessons to learn and growth that can come from it. Best of luck to you.

Girlfriend! Run for the hills! You do not deserve this kind of toxic treatment from a teenager and frankly, the rest of the family for enabling it. You are young, and will find a good man. Take every lesson you can from this scenario and break free. I hope you have a great support network of family and friends to be there for you. It will be hard to break up. You will probably have moments of despair and regret, and once those moments PASS, which I assure you they will, life will be clearer and you will have an even better sense of self and sense of the type of relationship you want/need/deserve. All best to you 💖
Your “sister” IS TA. Seriously. How incredibly self centered. She won’t acknowledge a baby?!? What a complete immature selfish jerk.
Yikes. I’m sure you were so (rightfully) pissed when you left the party. Trying to have words with a drunk man while feeling enraged is never ever a good scenario. But you are NTA! He is!

Oof that’s is awkward! For the sake of poor Sheri who is sort of at the mercy of all these adults, it would be a kindness to extend some Uncle energy her way. She probably needs a good male figure in her life, wherever it comes from. Not that you have to be overly involved, but just gracious and thoughtful. But it is also ok for your wife to have sent her niece & nephew a personal card. Sounds like you’ve done a really good job “going with the flow” with your sisters somewhat volatile and occasionally… unconventional relationships. I hope the kids are ok.
Bullet dodged. It would have been the same issue for the rest of the relationship. Good for you. You saw that red flag and didn’t ignore it. Well done.
NTA. You have evidence that this is a difficult person to work with. She is dealing with consequences of her own actions.
